subject: Vendor onboarding: preferred invoice channel + multi-PO handling
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@marigoldhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice channel question

Hi Soojin / Vanessa,

Thanks for starting vendor onboarding for Marigold Health. We completed the onboarding form (attached) and attached a representative invoice to show our current layout. A couple quick questions so we set expectations correctly before go‑live: 

- Do you prefer we submit invoices directly into your supplier portal or email them to an AP inbox?
- If email is acceptable as a fallback, what subject line / tokens should we include so invoices auto‑route to the right ledger / PO?
- We sometimes consolidate multiple POs onto a single PDF (header + multiple PO sections). Is that okay or do you require a separate file per PO?

Attached: marigold-sample-invoice.pdf, marigold-onboarding-form.xlsx

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Director, Finance Operations
Marigold Health
elena@marigoldhealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@marigoldhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice channel question

Hi Elena — thanks for the form and sample. Quick answers and a couple of requests below.

1) Preferred channel: portal first. Our supplier portal guarantees PO matching, faster ACKs, and automated remittance processing. We strongly recommend onboarding to the portal before your first invoice. Link to the portal invite will be sent from our vendor-ops team after we finish the enrollment steps.

2) Email fallback: acceptable during transition but needs a strict subject token so our parser can assign invoices to the correct AP entity. Please use this exact subject format when emailing invoices: "INVOICE | MARIGOLDHEALTH | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>". If you have multiple POs on a single PDF, include all PO numbers separated by commas in the PO: field (e.g., PO:12345,12346).

3) Multi‑PO on one PDF: allowed, but there are two caveats —
  - Each PO line must include an itemized row that clearly maps to the PO (we use OCR + token matching).
  - For reconciliation, we prefer one invoice per remittance cycle; if the invoice spans billing for multiple POs and multiple remit entities, send separate files per remit entity.

4) VAT / tax lines: include a separate tax summary table at the bottom of the PDF and ensure your currency and tax IDs are present on the header. 

I'll copy our AP ops lead (Monica) on follow up to confirm the exact fallback ACK SLA and where to CC the email. Attached I'm also sharing a compact CSV sample we prefer for portal imports — use it as a template if you export invoice lineitems.

Next steps:
- We will send the portal invitation by EOD Wed after we process your onboarding form.
- If you need to send an immediate invoice, use the subject token above and CC ap-team@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Sooy
—
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-invoice-csv-sample.csv (csv)

- We issue a monthly consolidated invoice that covers all POs within that month (single PDF). Will Redwood accept a monthly consolidated file if each PO section is clearly marked and includes line‑level PO mapping?
- If we include multiple remit entities (one invoice covers two legal entities that share the same account), should we split those into two PDFs to avoid manual reconciliation?
- Last: do you require PDF/A for archival, or is normal PDF ok?

(Attaching a second sample showing two PO sections in one PDF to illustrate.)

Best,
Elena

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@marigoldhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, ap-team@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice channel question

Hi Elena — Monica from AP Ops here. Quick operational clarifications to make go‑live smooth: 

- Consolidated monthly PDFs are accepted if each PO section contains a clear PO header and itemized mapping. Our parser will split and route lines based on the PO tokens; however, there is a small manual-posting rate for consolidated files (~5–7% of lines) if OCR confidence is low.
- If the invoice covers multiple remit/legal entities, please split into separate PDFs per remit entity. That avoids delayed remits and manual reclass.
- PDF/A is not required today — a regular text-searchable PDF is preferred (no scanned images-only). If you must send scans, please ensure 300dpi and searchable OCR.

Operational asks for email fallback: 
1) Subject: "INVOICE | MARIGOLDHEALTH | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>" (if multiple POs, list them all in PO: field).
2) To: invoices@redwood.com; CC: ap-team@redwood.com (this ensures ACK and creates a ticket).
3) Attach: one PDF per remit entity; include a short CSV (optional) with line‑level breakdown to speed processing.

We'll proceed with the portal invite today. Expected timeline: portal account + SSO invite within 48 hours after we validate your onboarding form.

Can you confirm you'll: 1) move to the portal when invited, and 2) for any interim emails follow the subject format above and send to invoices@redwood.com?

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Accounts Payable Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
